Metadata.Title: ALIENATION
Metadata.Name: Enable debug mode
Metadata.Note: Makes is_debug_enabled() return true, as if the ANDEBUGXXXXXXXXX debug add-on were owned. Controls need a USB keyboard. F1 shows the engine debug overlay; F2/F3 change page (GUI, Tweakables, Performance, GFX memory and more). In levels: Q god mode, W demigod, K kill all enemies, O teleport, Y wallhack, Numpad 0 debug camera. Full key map in docs/developer-hooks.md. Confirmed working on console.
Metadata.Author: Claude

Metadata.Title: ALIENATION
Metadata.Name: 60 FPS
Metadata.Note: Gameplay runs at 29.97 fps (menus already run at 59.94). Forces every engine_set_fps() call to 59.94, which halves the fixed game-logic step and switches the video flip rate to 60 Hz, so game speed is unchanged. Also changes every per-frame time step hard-coded as 1/30 to 1/60, so the effects keep their speed: the render time step, hologram shader animation, a render animation phase, the weather/rain per-frame count and the online sync timer. If the console can't hold 60 fps the game slows down rather than dropping frames (max frame skip is 0, as it was at 30). Pair with Resolution 720p for headroom.
Metadata.Author: Claude

Metadata.Title: ALIENATION
Metadata.Name: Resolution 720p (1280x720)
Metadata.Note: Lowers the render and output resolution from the fixed 1920x1080 to 1280x720 (about 44% of the pixels), for a steadier frame rate with the 60 FPS patch. The console scales the 720p image to your TV. Every render target is sized from this one value, so GPU memory use drops and the 1 GB render-target pool is left unchanged. Expect a softer image and text. Untested on console.
Metadata.Author: Claude

Metadata.Title: ALIENATION
Metadata.Name: Skip intro videos
Metadata.Note: Skips the boot logo video (video/splash.mp4, or splash_SIE.mp4 in Korea) and the narrated intro (video/intro.mp4). Those two files are made to fail to open, which takes the boot script's own no-video path: the game continues straight to loading and the title screen with no timeout. The title-screen background video and other videos are unaffected. Untested on console.
Metadata.Author: Claude

Metadata.Title: ALIENATION
Metadata.Name: Fast weapon scrapping
Metadata.Note: Shortens the hold-L3 scrap time while keeping it longer for rarer weapons: 0.3 / 0.4 / 0.5 / 0.75 / 1.0 s from lowest to highest rarity (the game's own times are 0.5 / 0.5 / 0.5 / 1.0 / 2.0). Holding L3 doesn't speed it up, and releasing resets the bar. The times are a script constant in stream.dat (props.sell_times); the patch rewrites them in memory when the game loads its scripts. Untested on console.
Metadata.Author: Claude
